Subject: Request: comp approval for L5 ML Infra — Alex Romero

Hi team,

Quick summary: Alex Romero (ex-DataScale) completed on-site this week. Strong infra background (LLM serving, CUDA optimizations), recommended for L5 (senior). Interview panel scorecard attached.

Proposed comp to put on the table:
- Base: $220,000
- Target bonus: 15% (on-target)
- Equity: 0.25% (4y vest, 1y cliff) — proposed as RSU grant
- Sign-on: $15,000 (to offset counter from current employer)

Notes / ask:
- Hiring plan shows budget up to $240k for L5 in US West, but recommendation was conservative.
- We want to move quickly; candidate expects an offer this week.

Please confirm if comp is approvable or if we should push base higher (I think we can flex within the band up to $235k without additional approvals). If we go above $235k, will need VP sign-off.

Attachments: scorecard_Alex_Romero.pdf (panel comments), draft_offer_template.docx

Thanks,
Ava

Thanks, Ava — good candidate. A few notes:

- I agree with moving faster on base rather than a large sign-on. For long-term retention the equity mix matters more.
- Can we do Base $230,000, Bonus 12% and Equity 0.20% (4y)? That keeps total comp competitive but leaves room for future refresh.
- Headcount: People Ops confirmed this is an active open req (HIRE-472) and spot is available.

If Monica confirms HR is good with $230k base within the band, mark me as approved. If $235k or higher is required, please ping Laura for VP sign-off.

-Markus

Hi all,

HR/Comp update after checking banding and current market comps:
- Official L5 band (US-West) shows base range $180k — $240k.
- Typical on-target bonus for L5s is 10%—15%; comp committee prefers 12% for new hires in infra roles.

Recommendation to send offer:
- Base: $230,000
- Bonus: 12% (target)
- Equity: 0.20% (RSU equivalent) with 4-year vest schedule, 1-year cliff
- Sign-on: $12,000 (one-time)

Rationale: $230k base places the offer competitively vs. his counter (they asked for $235k). Keeping equity slightly lower (0.20%) preserves band budget for higher promo adjustments later. Sign-on reduced to $12k to keep cash spend manageable.

I will prepare the formal offer packet (pdf) and route for e-signature once I have Markus / Laura "thumbs up". If Laura is OK with this, we can extend verbal today and send DocuSign.

Attachment: Alex_Romero_offer_20260329.pdf (draft)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Recruiter, Technical Hiring
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Romero <alex.romero@gmail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-29T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer — Redwood Inference (L5 ML Infra)

Monica, Markus — thank you for the quick turnaround and for the offer. I got the PDF and reviewed the terms. Everything looks good; I have one ask: would it be possible to keep the 1y cliff but accelerate to a 3-year full vest (3y total) instead of 4y? That would help align with my personal plans.

If not possible, I can accept the 4y schedule. I am aiming for a start date of May 4th.

Best,
Alex
